Maya Chen: 18 minutes until all-hands. Quick check-in: remote presenter joining via NDI — Zoe, you good? Also, any slide version friction?
Zoe - Eng (remote): Seeing intermittent NDI frames dropping on my side, audio fine. If it gets flaky I can dial in via phone and share screens.
Devon - AV: We can take NDI -> HDMI passthrough. If Zoe's feed drops, we'll switch to backup laptop and start a local capture.
Lin (SRE): Recorder healthy. Note: last week's upload stalled due to IAM token expiry; I've extended the service token TTL for this bucket. recorder-bot should retry if upload fails.
recorder-bot: Local recording started. Will upload to s3://redwood-recordings/all-hands/2813502468/ when complete.
Priya Gomez: Heads-up: slide deck version mismatch - two presenters pushed edits. I've consolidated changes into v3 (link in drive). Please use v3.
Maya Chen: @Zoe if NDI degrades, please post in this thread and use the phone fallback number (pinned). We'll switch slides to presenter mode.
Zoe - Eng (remote): Copy. I'll also keep my phone on standby.
Devon - AV: Quick commands if capture process dies on av-box:
```
sudo systemctl status capture.service
sudo systemctl restart capture.service
# if disk full: sudo rm /tmp/av-cache/*
```
Lin (SRE): Also note: if inference-prod autopromote runs during the live demo, deploy-bot will pause auto-promote on high CPU. deploy-bot: status?
deploy-bot: No active autopromotes scheduled for the next 30m.
Priya Gomez: Queueing a leadership Q for Chris: "How will we sequence Dedicated GA vs Dedicated Optimize availability for paying customers?" I'll drop it into the Q&A doc.
Chris - CEO: I'll answer at high level during remarks; Product can follow up in AMA.
Maya Chen: AV plan: primary NDI -> if NDI drops, switch to backup HDMI laptop; if local recorder stalls, start B-cam passthrough and note incident. Priya, make sure the v3 deck is the one we present.
Priya Gomez: Done. v3 is live. Presenters, please confirm you're on v3.
Zoe - Eng (remote): Confirmed on v3. Starting screen share test now.
Maya Chen: Thanks. Final reminder: mute when not speaking, wired ethernet preferred, and post any urgent issues here. See you soon. :thumbsup:
